messages:
Lia Chen: Quick heads-up — Helios Therapeutics go-live on Dedicated is scheduled for Tue 08:00 UTC. Need final quorum on quota numbers, autoscale thresholds, and the two-step load test plan. Can SRE + CE confirm today?
Sam Ortega: On it. Do we have concrete RPS / tokens-min targets and the GPU SKU in the reserved pool?
Jordan Patel: Helios target: baseline ~75k tokens/min, peak bursts up to ~200k tokens/min for overnight batch jobs. They plan to run llama-3-70b-8q quantized variant for most traffic. Reserved pool is current gen A100-like, but the committed profile uses our 70B-8q runpath (expected throughput ~1.2x of 70B fp16).
Maya Rivers: Proposal: autoscale target utilization 70%, cooldown 90s, max instances 6. Enable prefix/KV cache priming during warmup window. Add fallback policy: if p95 > 600ms for 3 consecutive mins, route to 33B variant automatically.
Lia Chen: Perfect. Sam/Jordan — can you confirm the quota table by EOD? I’ll coordinate enablement with Helios CS and ops contact. Also adding load test snippets below.
Sam Ortega: Confirming I'll validate the pool and run capacity math. Quick note on quota: we should enforce per-minute tokens and per-request token caps to prevent noisy neighbors during burst. Recommended caps in thread after math.
Sam Ortega: ```
# synthetic load run command (internal load harness)
rdw-loadtest \  --target-tokens 120000 \  --duration 10m \  --concurrency 50 \  --model llama-3-70b-8q \  --endpoint https://dedicated-helios.redwood/api/generate \  --headers 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY'
```
Jordan Patel: Also propose guardrails: per-minute tokens = 250k, per-request tokens = 10k, max concurrent sessions = 200. That leaves room for burst and keeps tail latency affordable.
ops-bot: Scheduled: loadtest-hel-2026-03-24-09:00-UTC (owner: Sam Ortega)
Devon Li: I'll prepare warmup scripts and sample prompt set for cache priming. Will do a dry-run against staging tomorrow 09:30 UTC and post results.
Lia Chen: One renewal risk to flag: if first-week p95 misses SLA, Helios is likely to escalate and ask for credits. We should plan weekly quality syncs during week 0-2. @Maya can you own rollback & variant routing policy?
Maya Rivers: I'll own rollback policy + automatic variant routing. Also recommend we reserve a 2-hour burst window daily for planned batch runs so autoscale doesn't overshoot.
Sam Ortega: Ack. I'll open a Terraform PR to create the autoscale policy, quota objects, and the fallback route. PR target: EOD today, link will be posted in this thread.
Jordan Patel: I'll reach out to Helios PM for a final schedule confirm and collect prioritized prompt set (top 200 prompts).
Lia Chen: TL;DR action items: Sam - infra PR + capacity calc; Devon - warmup scripts + dry-run; Maya - rollback/variant routing + burst slot; Jordan - customer prompts + schedule; Lia - runbook + ops handoff. :thumbsup: Reconvene 10:00 UTC tomorrow for results.
Sam Ortega: +1. I'll post the capacity table here when PR is up.
Devon Li: Dry-run scheduled, will post logs and a short smoke checklist.
Maya Rivers: I'll draft the rollback playbook and include thresholds for automated and manual rollback (p50/p95/p99 triggers).
Jordan Patel: Confirmed outreach to Helios PM — they requested an extra 30m for runbook review after staging dry-run.
Lia Chen: Great — thanks everyone. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
ops-bot: Reminder: incident-bridge scheduled for go-live 08:00 UTC Tue (channel: #eng-oncall).
